parameters.query:
INSERT INTO leads_pipeline (
    contact_id, 
    conversation_id, 
    crm_deal_id, 
    ai_pain_point, 
    company_niche, 
    custom_pitch, 
    client_status, 
    source, 
    updated_at
) VALUES (
    $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (contact_id) DO UPDATE SET
    -- Эти поля обновляем всегда (разговор идет, статус меняется)
    conversation_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.conversation_id, leads_pipeline.conversation_id),
    crm_deal_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.crm_deal_id, leads_pipeline.crm_deal_id),
    client_status = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.client_status, leads_pipeline.client_status),
    source = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.source, leads_pipeline.source),
    
    -- 🛡 БРОНЯ ОТ ПЕРЕЗАПИСИ (Если пришла пустышка, оставляем старое значение)
    company_niche = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.company_niche IN ('Неизвестно', 'null', '') THEN leads_pipeline.company_niche ELSE EXCLUDED.company_niche END,
    ai_pain_point = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.ai_pain_point IN ('Не выявлено', 'null', '') THEN leads_pipeline.ai_pain_point ELSE EXCLUDED.ai_pain_point END,
    custom_pitch = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.custom_pitch IN ('Стандартный подход', 'null', '') THEN leads_pipeline.custom_pitch ELSE EXCLUDED.custom_pitch END,
    
    updated_at = NOW();

UPDATE leads_pipeline 
SET client_status = 'onboarding_receive',
    contract_data = $1::jsonb,
    updated_at = NOW() 
WHERE contact_id = $2;

SELECT 
    contract_data, 
    project_brief, 
    company_niche, 
    ai_pain_point, 
    custom_pitch 
FROM leads_pipeline 
WHERE contact_id = $1;
